title: Prepare for study
focus: Clean desk, decide questions for the next session, and keep the phone away.
checklist: Choose tomorrow's revision and new questions

title: Setup
focus: Sit at your study place, keep water nearby, and open only what you need.

title: Revise 2 old DSA questions
focus: Build confidence first by revising old questions before attempting anything new.

title: New DSA Question 1
focus: Think first, use hints carefully, then code and write a short pattern note.
checklist: 25 min: think and write brute force

title: Break
focus: Walk, drink water, maybe eat something light. Keep reels and YouTube closed.

title: New DSA Question 2
focus: Repeat the same careful process. Two new questions per day is enough.

title: Pattern notebook
focus: Make the learning permanent by recording patterns, mistakes, and tomorrow's revision.

title: Challenge / GitHub rough work
focus: Pick an easy question connected to what you studied and explain it in your own words.

title: Walk + mental revision
focus: Use the walk for light mental revision, not heavy content.
checklist: Explain it like an interview answer

title: Breakfast
focus: Eat, freshen up, and avoid getting stuck there if sleep is pending.

title: Main sleep
focus: Room dark, phone away, no guilt. Sleep is part of the study plan.

title: Wake/reset
focus: Wake up properly before touching the phone.

title: Lunch
focus: Have your meal and avoid letting it become several hours of random timepass.

title: Java / OOPs / SQL / placement subject
focus: Use this for a lighter placement topic instead of heavy DSA.

title: Break
focus: Free time, tea, snack, or rest.

title: DSA re-attempt block
focus: Pick one question solved at night and solve it again without seeing code.

title: Flexible / rest
focus: Family time, shower, college work, pending tasks, or relaxation. Keep naps short.
checklist: Limit nap to 25 minutes if needed

title: Dinner / family
focus: Keep it light and relaxed.

title: LinkedIn / GitHub challenge post
focus: Finalize the GitHub commit, LinkedIn post, notes screenshot, and challenge update.

title: Rest / personal time
focus: Guilt-free relaxation with a limit so you do not burn out.

title: Light concept revision
focus: Do not start a hard new question. Warm up with concepts, notes, dry runs, or one pattern.
